moduleOutcomes: All selected pam_unix and pam_limits hook statuses are explicit source-owned symbolic backend inputs; only pam_permit, pam_deny and pam_debug results derive directly from their deterministic module contracts. No real password crypto or installed distro stack is claimed.
passwordAPI: Application invokes pam_chauthtok; libpam supplies PAM_PRELIM_CHECK and PAM_UPDATE_AUTHTOK internally. Application must not pass those flags itself.
serviceSelection: Configuration IDs distinguish authored alternatives for a single physical service. Existing afs-login alternatives retain /etc/pam.d/afs-login; su --login selects su-l and non-login selects su; publickey SSH selects only account/session lines in /etc/pam.d/sshd.
bookkeeping: Successful setcred and partial-session records are explicit pedagogical transaction lifecycle records, not invented native credentials/resource handles. Selected pam_unix/debug/permit hooks may create no credentials. Real UID/GID/groups are caller-owned; no TGT is created.
conversation: Only selected pam_unix credential hooks request credential input in PAM01; control-only fixtures require no credential prompt. pam_debug can emit informational pam_info callbacks; these are not credential proof. Native helper handles information/error styles with libc-allocated empty response arrays and refuses credential prompts.
passwordGeneration: PRELIM failure collects no new token. UPDATE processing follows collection. Only successful selected local update commits verifier authority generation2; unsuccessful/unsupported paths retain generation1 and authenticated history without service.

publickeySshSettings.claim: Selected profile only, not a universal SSH default. Configured phase metadata is not proof it ran before its source event.
